contract: One checked absolute deadline bounds submission, queued callback admission and final observation of DNS, checked-address pinning, TLS, bounded body read and decoding.
A fixed pool retains at most sixteen physical workers and sixteen queued jobs. Expired unstarted jobs do not execute. A timed-out started job retains its physical worker until actual completion.

The outer fetch waiter releases its semaphore permit when the deadline wait returns. Initial Tokio blocking-queue time is outside this deadline; cancellation does not immediately release that waiter permit.

Root explicitly authorized queued receipt expiry. Started writes continue; unchanged Timeout mapping and traced failure propagation refuse dispatch or local success projection when the write or snapshot fails.

independent_source_review.scope: Bounded source approval of final producer; no runtime execution by reviewer.

composition_notes: Root comment-only follow-up describes bounded retained workers without claiming transport hard cancellation.
The shared state file also contains the separately reviewed signing-custody election fields. The trust inventory also includes independently verified reader relocation and cold-map test edges.

static_evidence.scope: Composed checker passed: 497 constructors, 88 tenant tables, 181 SQL contracts.

limits: The stalled TLS control models blocked work; it is not a live TLS trickle probe.
The helper unit control verifies the final observation guard. The end-to-end late-success case does not independently demonstrate that guard because its receive may time out first.
Thread-spawn panic, job-panic worker loss and reclamation of stuck native workers are not repaired by this change.
Producer genuine Originals, runtime gates and composed owning/strict qualification remain pending.
